### Health Analytics with R · Module 08: Reproducible Research & Deployment
***
**Learning objectives**
- Understand MLflow's four core concepts: tracking, models, registry, projects
- Log parameters, metrics, and artifacts for every training run
- Compare multiple model runs in a structured experiment
- Register the best model and manage staging/production lifecycle
- Build a model metadata schema for clinical model governance
- Implement drift detection with MLflow metrics over time

**Estimated time:** 2.5 hours | **Level:** Intermediate-Advanced | **Libraries:** `mlflow`, `tidymodels`, `xgboost`, `ranger`

## 1. Setup & Dataset

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(pROC)
library(rsample)
library(ranger)
library(xgboost)
library(jsonlite)
library(fs)

mod08_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod08")
dir.create(file.path(mod08_dir, "mlruns"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(mod08_dir, "runs"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

col_blue <- "#2563EB"
col_red  <- "#DC2626"
col_green <- "#16A34A"
col_gold <- "#D4A017"
col_navy <- "#1F4E79"

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line        = element_line(colour = "grey40")
    )
)

set.seed(42)
N <- 3000
sigmoid <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
age  <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 60, 15), 18), 90))
los  <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30))
dm   <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.35)
hf   <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.22)
copd <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.18)
logit <- -3.2 + 0.6 * hf + 0.5 * dm + 0.3 * copd + 0.02 * (age - 60) +
  0.2 * as.integer(los > 7) + rnorm(N, 0, 0.3)
readmitted <- rbinom(N, 1, sigmoid(logit))
df <- tibble(age = age, los_days = los, diabetes = dm, hf = hf, copd = copd,
             readmitted = readmitted)
FEATURES <- c("age", "los_days", "diabetes", "hf", "copd")
TARGET <- "readmitted"
split <- initial_split(df, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
train <- training(split)
test  <- testing(split)
X_tr <- train[FEATURES]; y_tr <- train[[TARGET]]
X_te <- test[FEATURES];  y_te <- test[[TARGET]]
cat(sprintf("Dataset: %d patients | Readmission: %.1f%%\n", N, mean(readmitted) * 100))
cat(sprintf("Train: %d | Test: %d\n", nrow(X_tr), nrow(X_te)))
```

## 2. MLflow Architecture

```
MLflow Tracking Server
├── Experiments (logical groupings)
│   └── readmission_prediction/
│       ├── Run 001: LogisticRegression (AUC=0.72)
│       ├── Run 002: RandomForest       (AUC=0.76)
│       └── Run 003: GradientBoosting  (AUC=0.78) ← BEST
└── Artifacts
    └── models/, figures/, feature_importance.csv

MLflow Model Registry
├── readmission_model (registered model)
│   ├── Version 1: Staging  (AUC=0.72)
│   ├── Version 2: Archived (AUC=0.76)
│   └── Version 3: Production (AUC=0.78) ← SERVING
```

## 3. MLflow Tracking Setup

```{r}
mlflow_ok <- requireNamespace("mlflow", quietly = TRUE)
if (mlflow_ok) {
  cat("mlflow R package available — using mlflow:: API where shown.\n")
  tracking_uri <- paste0("file:", file.path(mod08_dir, "mlruns"))
  tryCatch({
    mlflow::mlflow_set_tracking_uri(tracking_uri)
    mlflow::mlflow_set_experiment("readmission_prediction")
    cat("MLflow tracking URI:", tracking_uri, "\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("MLflow server not reachable; using JSON + RDS analogue.\n")
    mlflow_ok <<- FALSE
  })
} else {
  cat("install.packages('mlflow')  (proceeding with JSON + RDS tracking analogue)\n")
}

# JSON + RDS tracking analogue (always runs so the experiment is complete)
tracker_env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
tracker_env$experiment <- "readmission_prediction"
tracker_env$runs <- list()
tracker_env$tracking_dir <- file.path(mod08_dir, "runs")
dir.create(tracker_env$tracking_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
tracker_env$current_run <- NULL
tracker <- list(
  start_run = function(run_name) {
    tracker_env$current_run <- list(
      run_name = run_name, params = list(), metrics = list(), tags = list(),
      start_time = proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    )
  },
  log_param = function(key, value) tracker_env$current_run$params[[key]] <<- value,
  log_params = function(params) {
    for (k in names(params)) tracker_env$current_run$params[[k]] <<- params[[k]]
  },
  log_metric = function(key, value) {
    tracker_env$current_run$metrics[[key]] <<- round(as.numeric(value), 6)
  },
  log_metrics = function(metrics) {
    for (k in names(metrics)) tracker$log_metric(k, metrics[[k]])
  },
  set_tag = function(key, value) {
    tracker_env$current_run$tags[[key]] <<- as.character(value)
  },
  end_run = function() {
    tracker_env$current_run$duration_s <- round(
      proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - tracker_env$current_run$start_time, 2
    )
    tracker_env$runs[[length(tracker_env$runs) + 1]] <- tracker_env$current_run
    write_json(
      tracker_env$current_run,
      file.path(tracker_env$tracking_dir, paste0(tracker_env$current_run$run_name, ".json")),
      pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE
    )
  },
  get_runs_df = function() {
    map_dfr(tracker_env$runs, function(r) {
      params <- r$params; metrics <- r$metrics
      names(params) <- paste0("param.", names(params))
      names(metrics) <- paste0("metric.", names(metrics))
      bind_cols(
        tibble(run_name = r$run_name, duration_s = r$duration_s %||% 0),
        as_tibble(params), as_tibble(metrics)
      )
    })
  }
)

cat("Tracking initialised.\n")
cat("MLflow concepts this notebook covers:\n")
walk(
  c(
    "Experiments: group related runs",
    "Runs: single model training",
    "Parameters: hyperparameters logged",
    "Metrics: AUC, AP, Brier",
    "Artifacts: model files, figures, data",
    "Tags: free-form metadata",
    "Model Registry: versioned model store",
    "UI: http://localhost:5000"
  ),
  ~ cat("  *", .x, "\n")
)
```

```{r}
# mlflow:: API (shown even if the local file store is awkward)
MLFLOW_R_API <- paste(
  c(
    "library(mlflow)",
    "mlflow_set_tracking_uri('file:mlruns')",
    "mlflow_set_experiment('readmission_prediction')",
    "with(mlflow_start_run(run_name = 'GBM_v3'), {",
    "  mlflow_log_param('n_estimators', 200)",

    "  mlflow_log_model(model, 'model')",
    "  mlflow_log_artifact('reports/figures/roc_curve.png')",
    "})"
  ),
  collapse = "\n"
)
cat("Preferred mlflow:: tracking snippet:\n")
cat(MLFLOW_R_API, "\n")
```

## 4. Model Comparison Experiment

```{r}
avg_precision <- function(y, p) {
  ord <- order(p, decreasing = TRUE)
  y <- y[ord]
  tp <- cumsum(y)
  prec <- tp / seq_along(y)
  rec  <- tp / sum(y)
  # step-wise PR-AUC
  sum(diff(c(0, rec)) * prec)
}
brier_score <- function(y, p) mean((p - y)^2)

predict_prob <- function(fit, X, type) {
  if (type == "glm") {
    as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = X, type = "response"))
  } else if (type == "ranger") {
    pred <- predict(fit, data = X)$predictions
    if (is.matrix(pred)) pred[, colnames(pred) == "1" | colnames(pred) == "TRUE"] else pred
  } else if (type == "xgb") {
    predict(fit, as.matrix(X))
  }
}

train_glm <- function(C) {
  w <- ifelse(y_tr == 1, sum(y_tr == 0) / max(sum(y_tr == 1), 1), 1)
  glm(readmitted ~ age + los_days + diabetes + hf + copd,
      data = bind_cols(X_tr, readmitted = y_tr),
      family = binomial(), weights = w)
}

model_configs <- list(
  list(
    name = "LogisticRegression_L2", type = "glm",
    train = function() train_glm(1),
    params = list(model_type = "LogisticRegression", C = 1, max_iter = 500,
                  class_weight = "balanced")
  ),
  list(
    name = "LogisticRegression_strong", type = "glm",
    train = function() train_glm(0.1),
    params = list(model_type = "LogisticRegression", C = 0.1, max_iter = 500,
                  class_weight = "balanced")
  ),
  list(
    name = "RandomForest", type = "ranger",
    train = function() {
      ranger(
        as.factor(readmitted) ~ age + los_days + diabetes + hf + copd,
        data = bind_cols(X_tr, readmitted = y_tr),
        probability = TRUE, num.trees = 200, max.depth = 6, seed = 42
      )
    },
    params = list(model_type = "RandomForest", n_estimators = 200, max_depth = 6,
                  class_weight = "balanced")
  ),
  list(
    name = "GradientBoosting", type = "xgb",
    train = function() {
      xgb.train(
        params = list(objective = "binary:logistic", max_depth = 4, eta = 0.05,
                      eval_metric = "auc"),
        data = xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(X_tr), label = y_tr),
        nrounds = 200, verbose = 0
      )
    },
    params = list(model_type = "GradientBoosting", n_estimators = 200,
                  max_depth = 4, learning_rate = 0.05)
  )
)

cat("Running model comparison experiment...\n")
cat(sprintf("%-35s %9s %10s %8s %9s\n", "Run Name", "AUC-ROC", "Avg Prec", "Brier", "Time(s)"))
cat(strrep("-", 75), "\n")

fitted_models <- list()
for (config in model_configs) {
  t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  tracker$start_run(config$name)
  tracker$log_params(config$params)
  tracker$set_tag("dataset", "readmission_cohort")
  tracker$set_tag("features", paste(FEATURES, collapse = ","))

  fit <- config$train()
  fitted_models[[config$name]] <- fit
  prob <- predict_prob(fit, X_te, config$type)
  metrics <- list(
    auc_roc       = as.numeric(pROC::auc(y_te, prob, quiet = TRUE)),
    avg_precision = avg_precision(y_te, prob),
    brier_score   = brier_score(y_te, prob),
    n_train       = nrow(X_tr),
    n_test        = nrow(X_te),
    positive_rate = mean(y_te)
  )
  tracker$log_metrics(metrics)

  model_dir <- file.path(mod08_dir, "artifacts", config$name)
  dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(fit, file.path(model_dir, "model.rds"))

  elapsed <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0
  tracker$end_run()
  cat(sprintf("  %-33s %9.4f %10.4f %8.4f %9.2f\n",
              config$name, metrics$auc_roc, metrics$avg_precision,
              metrics$brier_score, elapsed))
}

runs_df <- tracker$get_runs_df()
cat("\nRun summary:\n")
print(runs_df %>% select(run_name, metric.auc_roc, metric.avg_precision, metric.brier_score))
```

## 5. Model Registry & Lifecycle

```{r}
best_run <- runs_df$run_name[which.max(runs_df$metric.auc_roc)]
best_auc <- max(runs_df$metric.auc_roc)

cat(sprintf("Best model: %s (AUC = %.4f)\n", best_run, best_auc))

REGISTRY_WORKFLOW <- list(
  Staging    = "Candidate model — integration tests passing",
  Production = "Live model serving patient predictions",
  Archived   = "Previous production versions (for rollback)"
)

registry <- list(
  model_name      = "readmission_v1",
  description     = "30-day readmission prediction - LR baseline",
  current_stage   = "Production",
  version_history = list(
    list(version = 1, run_name = "LogisticRegression_L2", stage = "Archived",
         auc = 0.71, promoted = "2023-06-01", note = "Initial baseline"),
    list(version = 2, run_name = "RandomForest", stage = "Archived",
         auc = 0.74, promoted = "2023-09-01", note = "RF improved AUC by 3pp"),
    list(version = 3, run_name = best_run, stage = "Production",
         auc = best_auc, promoted = "2024-01-15", note = "Current best model")
  )
)

cat("\nModel Registry:\n")
cat("  Name   :", registry$model_name, "\n")
cat("  Stage  :", registry$current_stage, "\n")
cat("\nVersion history:\n")
for (v in registry$version_history) {
  stage_icon <- list(Production = "[PROD]", Archived = "[ARCH]")[[v$stage]] %||% "[STAG]"
  cat(sprintf("  v%d %s %-35s AUC=%.4f  %s\n",
              v$version, stage_icon, v$run_name, v$auc, v$note))
}

registry_path <- file.path(mod08_dir, "model_registry.json")
write_json(registry, registry_path, pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
saveRDS(fitted_models[[best_run]], file.path(mod08_dir, "artifacts", "production_model.rds"))
cat("\nRegistry saved:", registry_path, "\n")
cat("Production model RDS:", file.path(mod08_dir, "artifacts", "production_model.rds"), "\n")
```

## 6. Experiment Visualisation

```{r}
metrics_to_plot <- c("metric.auc_roc", "metric.avg_precision", "metric.brier_score")
metric_labels   <- c("AUC-ROC", "Average Precision", "Brier Score")
better          <- c("higher", "higher", "lower")
colors <- c(col_red, col_blue, col_green, col_gold)

plot_list <- map(seq_along(metrics_to_plot), function(i) {
  metric <- metrics_to_plot[i]
  vals <- runs_df[[metric]]
  best_idx <- if (better[i] == "higher") which.max(vals) else which.min(vals)
  bar_colors <- colors[seq_len(nrow(runs_df))]
  bar_colors[best_idx] <- col_navy
  tibble(run = runs_df$run_name, val = vals, col = bar_colors) %>%
    ggplot(aes(run, val, fill = col)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.85, colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.4f", val)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = metric_labels[i],
         title = sprintf("%s\n(best = %s)", metric_labels[i],
                         if (better[i] == "higher") "max" else "min")) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1, size = 8))
})

fig <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(title = "MLflow Experiment: Model Comparison")
print(fig)
ggsave(file.path(mod08_dir, "mlflow_comparison.png"), fig,
       width = 15, height = 5, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
cat("Run comparison figure saved.\n")
```

## 8. Knowledge Check
1. You log 50 metrics per run. How do you decide which metrics are PRIMARY for model selection?
2. MLflow Model Registry has three stages: Staging, Production, Archived. What process should gate promotion from Staging to Production in a clinical context?
3. A new model has AUC=0.79 vs production model AUC=0.77. Should you always promote? What other factors matter?
4. Your MLflow database grows to 10GB after 6 months. What's your data management strategy?
5. Implement a model drift detector: log weekly AUC scores and alert when AUC drops >0.03 below the baseline.

```{r}
# Exercise 5 — Model drift detection
set.seed(42)
weeks <- 1:12
baseline_auc <- 0.780
weekly_aucs <- sapply(weeks, function(w) {
  if (w <= 8) baseline_auc + rnorm(1, 0, 0.01)
  else baseline_auc - 0.005 * (w - 8) + rnorm(1, 0, 0.01)
})
DRIFT_THRESHOLD <- baseline_auc - 0.03
drift_weeks <- weeks[weekly_aucs < DRIFT_THRESHOLD]

drift_df <- tibble(week = weeks, auc = weekly_aucs, drift = week %in% drift_weeks)
p_drift <- ggplot(drift_df, aes(week, auc)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = filter(drift_df, drift),
    aes(xmin = week - 0.4, xmax = week + 0.4, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    fill = col_red, alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(colour = col_blue, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = drift, colour = drift), size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = baseline_auc, colour = col_green, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = DRIFT_THRESHOLD, colour = col_red, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE" = col_blue, "TRUE" = col_red)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 16, "TRUE" = 6)) +
  labs(
    x = "Week", y = "AUC-ROC",
    title = "Model Performance Drift Monitoring\n(red markers = drift alert triggered)",
    colour = "Alert", shape = "Alert"
  )
print(p_drift)

cat("Drift alerts triggered in weeks:", paste(drift_weeks, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Action required: investigate data pipeline and consider model retraining\n")
```
